title: Alibi and Will
author: Edmund Ravensworth
blurb: Sable Crane, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
